title: Pre-approved loan offer
description: Promote a pre-approved personal loan on WhatsApp with limit, rate and a call to action. Marketing template for banks and lenders.
notes: Disclose the key term (rate or APR) in the message and keep opt-out in the footer; credit offers with vague claims are often rejected.

body.text: Good news, {{first_name}}! You have a pre-approved personal loan of up to *{{limit}}* with rates from {{rate}} per month. No paperwork, and the money can reach your account the same day.
